currentCard.explanation: Желчь вырабатывается клетками печени и помогает эмульгировать жиры в тонкой кишке. Желчный пузырь главным образом накапливает и концентрирует желчь между приёмами пищи.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: The Liver, Pancreas, and Gallbladder

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Liver23.6 L31 explicitly says liver produces bile; L45/L53 identify bile-producing hepatocytes. L31/L58/L79-L83 instead assign storage/concentration/release to gallbladder and L64-L75 pancreatic juice/enzymes/hormones to pancreas. Lymphatic21.1 L143-L149 supplies spleen blood-filter/immune role. Thus exactly liver answers bile production, not the nearby storage organ. All four are real abdominal organs with similarly short names; ordinary standalone nominative naming is consistent.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: The first sentence combines direct bile synthesis by hepatocytes(L45/L53) with its role emulsifying lipids in small intestine(L52-L55). The second correctly assigns between-meal storage/concentration mainly to gallbladder(L58/L79-L83). It does not equate emulsification with enzymatic hydrolysis, or deny liver continuous bile production while gallbladder stores it. Two concise Russian sentences directly name liver and distinguish the tempting gallbladder alternative.

absoluteLevel.ground: Liver produces bile is broad school/general adult digestive anatomy; distinguishing producer from the familiar gallbladder storage organ is a meaningful accessible association, not specialist histology or a rare numerical fact. Three real related abdominal organs keep the row plausible. Exact hepatocyte/lipid-emulsification and spleen details are explanatory extras, not required to answer. Editorial EASY assessment, not measured human acceptance.
